QUOTE: "When it is defined, the wrapper expands to the plain member name." and "In the default configuration it expands to `private_##member`... the rename makes direct access fail to compile."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that code defining MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS (library, sample programs) sees plain member names, and that default consumers of the public headers see the `private_`-renamed members.
